summary: The resource sidebar in stui and the phone lists, opens and files pull requests, repositories and other observed graph resources

replay.detail: No daemon replay change; edits use the existing arrangement.edited registers.

compatibility.detail: Clients use the existing optional resources.list route. Unknown resource vocabulary facts remain usable; missing reads leave other sidebar kinds working. Spaces can hold opaque resource: pane keys; older clients keep unknown tabs. No required wire fields or daemon schema change.

manual.detail: No manual migration. Resource catalogs refresh on opening their views; missing rows remain retained.

recovery.detail: No daemon recovery change; missing resource rows remain until explicitly cleared.
